item.title: Fork Calendar 0.16.26
item.description: Compact header in the title bar. Week and day views always fit the full day to the window (no zoom, no vertical scroll). Time zone picker for events. New-event panel has a Describe it box: type the event in words (day, time, length, time zone, place, link, repeats, guests, Google Meet) and it fills the form, asking when something is unclear. The new event's placeholder on the calendar follows the form.
